lines.en: The mata-mata shifts its limbs slowly.
It creeps forward along the bottom.

lines.zh: 背甲上的棱脊像枯树皮
lines.en: Ridges on its shell look like dead bark.

lines.zh: 它一歪一歪地拖着身体
lines.en: It drags itself along at an angle.

lines.zh: 它划过泥沙，几乎不留痕
lines.en: It slides over silt barely leaving a mark.
Its head extends straight ahead.
It works around a sunken log.
Its limbs paddle in small strokes.
It squeezes between water plants.
It lunges forward, then halts.
It looks like a rotting leaf that walks.
It edges toward the shallows.
The mata-mata lies utterly still.
Its head withdraws partway.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子伸出水面吸气
lines.en: It pokes its snout up for air.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在泥水里发暗
lines.en: Its eyes are dull in the muddy water.
Algae on its shell sways with the water.
Its mouth opens and its throat swells.

lines.zh: 它的喉部一动一动地抽水
lines.en: Its throat pumps water in and out.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在石头上等你。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the stone and wait for you.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼从它嘴边游过
lines.en: A small fish swims past its mouth.
It does not move; it waits.

lines.zh: 它慢慢把脖子伸展出去
lines.en: Its neck telescopes out slowly.
It rubs its shell in the mud.

lines.zh: 它把一只前爪抬了很久
lines.en: It holds one foreleg up for a long time.

lines.zh: 水面的光斑停在它背上
lines.en: A patch of light settles on its back.
The mata-mata rolls an eye toward you.

lines.zh: 它的头一动不动地对着你
lines.en: Its head points at you, motionless.
It takes you for a rock.
It lifts its head and its snout pulses.
Its throat swells once.
It shifts forward a little and stops.
No hostility, only appraisal.
It is judging whether you are edible.
Its head retracts slowly.

lines.zh: 它对你的影子更感兴趣
lines.en: Your shadow interests it more.
Its eye rolls to the other side.
It watches your feet, not your face.
Its mouth hangs very slightly open.
It looks like mud that has grown eyes.

lines.zh: 它左右试探了一下你的轮廓
lines.en: It probes your outline left and right.
It tilts its head a fraction.

lines.zh: 它确认你不是水草，便不动了
lines.en: Having ruled out weed, it stops trying.
It watches you with terrible patience.

lines.zh: 枯叶龟被碰，缩了一下头
lines.en: Touched, the mata-mata pulls its head in.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪开，动作很急不得
lines.en: It edges away as fast as it can, which is slow.
A pale mark shows on its shell.
Its throat pulses twice.
It presses itself into the mud.
It gapes its mouth in a threat.

lines.zh: 它翻了半个身，又正过来
lines.en: It tips half over and rights itself.
It hides under the water plants.

lines.zh: 它慢慢沉下去，不再露面
lines.en: It sinks away and does not resurface.

lines.zh: 这点伤它忍得住，只是躲远了
lines.en: It bears the wound and keeps its distance.

lines.zh: 枯叶龟的喉部鼓了起来
lines.en: The mata-mata's throat balloons.
It opens its mouth toward the scent.
It vacuums water into its mouth.

lines.zh: 它慢吞吞地挪到食物旁
lines.en: It crawls slowly to the food.
It clamps on and pulls patiently.

lines.zh: 它把整块肉慢慢吞下去
lines.en: It swallows the meat whole, slowly.
Done, it still sits with its mouth open.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子凑到你的手指
lines.en: Its snout comes to your fingers.

lines.zh: 它慢得让你以为它不饿
lines.en: It moves so slowly you doubt it is hungry.

lines.zh: 它吸了一口气，喉咙鼓得很大
lines.en: It inhales, throat swelling wide.

lines.zh: 你碰到枯叶龟，它没反应
lines.en: You touch the mata-mata; nothing happens.

lines.zh: 它被推得挪了半个身位
lines.en: The push shifts it half a body length.

lines.zh: 它的四肢慢慢划回原位
lines.en: Its limbs paddle it back into place.

lines.zh: 它的背甲像粗糙的树皮
lines.en: Its shell feels like rough bark.
Its head dips in, then back out.
It slides aside without contesting.
You nearly step on its back.
It crawls slowly clear of your boot.

lines.zh: 它的爪子刮了下你的鞋
lines.en: A claw scrapes your shoe.

lines.zh: 它对你毫无反应，只是挪开
lines.en: It shows no reaction but moves off.

lines.zh: 两只枯叶龟并排趴在水底
lines.en: Two mata-matas lie together on the bottom.

lines.zh: 它们的头对着同一个方向
lines.en: Their heads point the same way.

lines.zh: 一只把鼻子搭在另一只背上
lines.en: One rests its snout on the other's shell.
They nudge each other slowly.
Their throat pulses keep time.

lines.zh: 它们挤在同一丛水草里
lines.en: They crowd into the same clump of weed.

lines.zh: 两只壳在泥里几乎看不出
lines.en: Both shells nearly vanish in the mud.

lines.zh: 它们没有动作，只是挨着
lines.en: They do nothing but stay close.

lines.zh: 水面的光照在两只背上
lines.en: Light falls across both shells.
They stay like that a long while.
The mata-mata inhales the food.
It bites and hauls it backwards.
It presses the item into the mud.

lines.zh: 它用爪子拨开泥找碎屑
lines.en: A claw scrapes the mud for scraps.

lines.zh: 它闭着眼也能找到食物
lines.en: It finds food without opening its eyes.
What it dislikes, it spits out.
It swallows too fast and gags.
It buries its head to rummage.
It surfaces with the item in its mouth.
Done, it sinks back to the bottom.

lines.zh: 枯叶龟的喉部猛地一鼓
lines.en: Its throat swells sharply.
Its mouth opens to the widest.

lines.zh: 它朝你的方向一寸寸挪
lines.en: It inches toward you.

lines.zh: 它把你当成了大块的肉
lines.en: It has taken you for a large piece of meat.
Its neck extends further than before.
It halts as if taking aim.
It slowly squares itself.
Its movements stay slow.

lines.zh: 但它的方向始终对着你
lines.en: But it always faces you.
It begins drawing water into its throat.

lines.zh: 它把前爪插进泥里稳住
lines.en: It digs its foreclaws into the mud.
Its mouth has not closed.
It shows its head from behind the weeds.
It no longer takes you for a rock.
It puffs a little water at you.
Its neck swells longer still.

lines.zh: 枯叶龟贴着你脚边移动
lines.en: The mata-mata slides along by your feet.
It aims at your ankle.
It closes an inch at a time.
No hurry, and no giving up.
Mouth open, throat swelling.

lines.zh: 枯叶底下，我绕到你背后。
lines.en: Under the dead leaves, I slip behind you.
It only moves when you do.
Its eyes barely move.

lines.zh: 它把身体压低贴住水底
lines.en: It flattens against the bottom.

lines.zh: 它在等一个能一口吞的距离
lines.en: It waits for one-gulp range.
It stirs a small cloud of mud.
Its head sways gently side to side.
It is estimating how wide you are.

lines.zh: 它试着张了下嘴，又合上
lines.en: It tests a gape and shuts it.

lines.zh: 它已经贴到你的影子里
lines.en: It has slid into your shadow.

lines.zh: 它把所有时间都用来靠近
lines.en: It spends all its time closing in.

lines.zh: 它忽然不动，是因为太近了
lines.en: The sudden stillness means it is close enough.
Its mouth aims at your foot.

lines.zh: 枯叶龟张嘴咬住你的脚
lines.en: The mata-mata bites your foot.
It gulps water, mud and all.
Its mouth opens wider than its head.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的裤脚往后拖
lines.en: It bites your trouser leg and pulls.

lines.zh: 你用脚把它推开，它又回来
lines.en: You shove it off; it comes back.

lines.zh: 它的爪子刮在你脚背上
lines.en: Its claws rake your instep.
Its jaws close with a damp thud.
Slow, but once it bites it holds.
Second bite, far more precise.
It gets turned over in the effort.

lines.zh: 它整张嘴吸住你的小腿
lines.en: Its whole mouth seals onto your calf.
It uses the water pressure to shove in.

lines.zh: 它的喉部一鼓一缩地拉扯
lines.en: Its throat pumps and tugs.
Small teeth, but a solid grip.
It lets go, backs up, and gapes again.

lines.zh: 它慢慢爬回水草里藏着
lines.en: It crawls back into the weeds to hide.

lines.zh: 水底的一团烂叶动了一下
lines.en: A heap of dead leaves on the bottom moves.
The mata-mata heaves out of the mud.
Muddy water runs off its shell.
It pokes its snout above the surface.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼被它惊得游开
lines.en: A small fish darts away from it.
It settles slowly onto the shallows.

lines.zh: 藻类还挂在它的甲缝里
lines.en: Algae still clings to its shell seams.

lines.zh: 它把头伸向前方，开始巡游
lines.en: It extends its head and starts to patrol.
It stops beside a sunken log.

lines.zh: 几乎没有声音，它就出现了
lines.en: It appears with almost no sound.
A few bubbles rise to the surface.
Its limbs spread out slowly.

lines.zh: 螺纹状的背甲浮在浅水里
lines.en: Its ridged shell breaks the shallows.

lines.zh: 它顶了一下水草，水草晃了
lines.en: It nudges the weeds; they sway.

lines.zh: 它从沉木的阴影里出来
lines.en: It comes out of the sunken log's shadow.
The head arrives before the body.

lines.zh: 它看上去完全不像活的
lines.en: It looks altogether lifeless.
And then it starts to move.

lines.zh: 壳被烫得发白，它猛地钻水
lines.en: Heat bleaches its shell; it dives.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，它四爪拼命扒
lines.en: Dropped on land, its claws scrabble.

lines.zh: 它被泥水闷住，拼命伸头
lines.en: Choked by mud, it strains to raise its head.
The blast flips it half around.
An arrow pins into the rim of its shell.
Odd force hits; all four feet kick.

lines.zh: 饿了很久，它连头都不伸了
lines.en: Starving, it will not even extend its head.
Lightning freezes it in the mud.
The void pulls and the mud cannot hold it.
